mapper.select: SELECT apt_seq, dong_code, sido_name, gugun_name, dong_name, apt_name, jibun, latest_deal_amount, exclu_use_ar, latitude, longitude, views, build_year FROM housecards WHERE CAST(latitude AS DECIMAL(10,6)) BETWEEN #{latA} AND #{latB} AND CAST(longitude AS DECIMAL(10,6)) BETWEEN #{lngA} AND #{lngB}

SELECT apt_seq, dong_code, sido_name, gugun_name, dong_name, apt_name, jibun, latest_deal_amount, exclu_use_ar, latitude, longitude, views, build_year, LEAST( ABS(CAST(latitude AS DECIMAL(10,6)) - #{lat}) + ABS(CAST(longitude AS DECIMAL(10,6)) - #{lng}), ABS(CAST(latitude AS DECIMAL(10,6)) - #{lat}) + ABS(CAST(longitude AS DECIMAL(10,6)) - #{lng}) ) AS distance_approx FROM housecards WHERE CAST(latitude AS DECIMAL(10,6)) BETWEEN #{lat} - 0.9 AND #{lat} + 0.9 AND CAST(longitude AS DECIMAL(10,6)) BETWEEN #{lng} - 1.14 AND #{lng} + 1.14 ORDER BY distance_approx LIMIT 100
